text.en: Many dog owners celebrate clean, fresh-smelling grooms and tidy trims for poodles and corgis, praising skilled groomers like Vlada and Marcus. Conversely, multiple critical reviews report uneven terrier-style cuts on poodles, as well as grooming-related skin bumps and unaddressed injuries.

title.en: Helpful attendants with customer service gaps

text.en: Clients frequently describe staff members as friendly, accommodating, and gentle with pets during routine visits and quick nail trims. However, dissatisfied pet parents express frustration when managers failed to follow up on voiced concerns or provide transparent communication after incidents occurred.

title.en: Happy returns contrasted with minor injuries

text.en: Several regulars note that their dogs arrive excitedly wagging their tails and return home happy and energized after daycare and baths. On the other hand, multiple reviewers reported distressing incidents, including a bruised eye, a torn nail, and painful cuts discovered only after leaving the facility.

q.en: Are walk-in appointments available for pet nail trims?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that the salon accommodates walk-in nail trims for dogs and cats without requiring prior appointments.

q.en: What grooming services does Dharma Dog Services offer?

a.en: The facility provides full bathing, coat haircuts, breed-specific styling, sanitary trims, and ear cleaning.

q.en: Does the facility offer dog daycare alongside grooming?

a.en: Yes, the Fraser Street location operates both a dog daycare facility and a full-service grooming salon.

q.en: What should owners do to ensure specific grooming preferences are met?

a.en: Reviewers recommend communicating styling instructions directly with the assigned groomer at intake to prevent misunderstandings.
